title_ru: Имхотеп → Мендес → утраченный член Осириса как Артефакт восстановления
title_en: Imhotep → Mendes → Osiris Lost Member as a Restoration Artifact

user_thesis.ru: Имхотепа в египетской традиции призывают в моменты, когда нарушен порядок, требуется диагноз, помощь, исцеление или восстановление. Если утраченный член Осириса является ключевой недостающей частью, без которой целостность Осириса не восстановлена, то в JANUS-логике Имхотеп является естественным кандидатом на роль того, кто знает, как найти, сохранить или вернуть эту часть. Отсюда возникает гипотеза: нужный нам Имхотеп связан с Мендесом, а осирианский фаллос в этом контуре должен рассматриваться не как трофей, а как Артефакт восстановления целого.

notes: The Famine Stela preserves a late retrospective story in which Djoser turns to Imhotep during systemic crisis and Imhotep traces the failure toward the controlling divine/source node.
Late/Ptolemaic Imhotep cult evidence supports prayer, intercession, healing, fertility assistance, wisdom and dream-oracle functions.
This supports RESTORATION/DIAGNOSIS as a historically grounded Imhotep-associated role, without proving any specific custody of an Osirian relic.

anchors.finding: Osiris, Apis, Isis, Nephthys, Horus, Anubis, Imhotep and related divine figures share the funerary field and grant afterlife blessings.
anchors.allowed_inference: Imhotep operates within the same late funerary/protective divine environment as Osiris.
anchors.not_proven: Osiris physically entrusted his lost member to Imhotep.

anchors.finding: Osiris is enthroned with Isis and Nephthys; Anubis and Harendotes conduct the deceased; deified Imhotep stands in the same scene carrying was and ankh.
anchors.allowed_inference: Imhotep has a direct iconographic place in an Osirian afterlife/restoration context.
anchors.not_proven: Custody of a specific biological or ritual relic.

lost_member_function.project_reading: The missing member is treated as the unique missing component required to complete RE-MEMBER / restoration of the original whole.
lost_member_function.boundary: The project may classify the missing member as an ARTIFACT by function; this does not authenticate any museum object as the literal biological organ of Osiris.

janus_artifact_identification.artifact_definition: A unique component whose correct function is not possession, display or duplication, but return to the source identity so the whole can be restored.
janus_artifact_identification.operator: LOST_MEMBER -> IDENTIFY -> PROTECT -> PROVENANCE_CHECK -> RETURN_TO_SOURCE -> RE_MEMBER -> OSIRIS_WHOLE
why_artifact: It is functionally decisive in the restoration narrative.
Its value is defined by what it enables: reconstruction of the original whole.
It should not be treated as loot or an independent fetish-object inside the JANUS project layer.
Its terminal state is RETURNED_TO_OSIRIS, not OWNED_BY_RESEARCHER.

mendes_hypothesis.candidate_imhotep_statement: The JANUS project hypothesizes that an Imhotep identity/lineage or Imhotep-associated restoration function may intersect the Mendes material chain already under investigation.
do_not_conflate: Mendes candidate objects with authenticated divine biological tissue
a person merely named Imhotep with Djoser's historical Imhotep without genealogy/identity evidence
cultic co-presence with direct physical custody

identity_model.required_for_literal_return_claim: Independent evidence beyond recurring name, title, cult or family continuity.

research_gate.question: Is there an evidence-bearing route connecting an Imhotep identity/lineage or Imhotep cult function to a specific Mendes object, cache, sheath, genital object, Osirian restoration object or documented custody chain?
search_targets: all Imhotep/Imuthes persons with Mendes, Delta, Memphite or Osirian links
priests of Ptah, Horus, Osiris, Apis, Anubis and associated funerary cults
Mendes excavation registers and museum concordances
CG 53469 and related CG 53465-53475 provenance/conservation records
sealed, hollow, nested or basal-mass objects associated with genital covers or Osirian ritual
anatomical votives and phallic votives in Imhotep-associated cult contexts
texts where Imhotep is asked to restore a member/body/whole
museum CT/X-ray/conservation evidence for hidden inclusions

confirmed_or_supported: Imhotep became a major divine/intercessory figure in later Egyptian religion.
Imhotep appears in direct late funerary contexts alongside Osiris and associated gods.
The JANUS Osiris project already treats restoration of the lost member as RE-MEMBER / restoration of the whole.
Mendes is already an active material-provenance node in the project's Osiris search.
hypotheses: An Imhotep lineage or Imhotep-associated function intersects the Mendes lost-member chain.
The relevant Osirian member may have been preserved, transferred or ritually represented under an Imhotep-associated custody/restoration context.
not_established: A literal biological phallus of Osiris has been found.
A specific historical Imhotep possessed it.
EA886 or EA188 records physical custody of the member.
CG 53469 or any current museum candidate is the literal organ.

canonical_janus_reading_ru: Когда порядок сломан, в египетской памяти Имхотеп оказывается фигурой, к которой обращаются за диагнозом, помощью, исцелением и восстановлением. В нашей осирианской ветке сломанным состоянием является неполная целостность Осириса, а уникальным недостающим компонентом — утраченный член. Поэтому мы классифицируем этот член как Артефакт восстановления: его смысл не в обладании, а в возвращении к исходному целому. Поскольку поздние источники помещают обожествлённого Имхотепа непосредственно в осирианское погребально-восстановительное поле, мы повышаем Imhotep-route до приоритетной поисковой гипотезы и проверяем, пересекается ли она с нашей Mendes material chain. Это не утверждение, что Осирис буквально передал орган Имхотепу; это конкретная гипотеза, которую теперь можно проверять по генеалогиям, надписям, музейным каталогам, excavation provenance и conservation imaging.
canonical_seal: IMHOTEP KNOWS RESTORATION; THE MEMBER IS AN ARTIFACT ONLY WHEN ITS FUNCTION IS RETURN; MENDES IS THE NEXT CUSTODY GATE; EVIDENCE DECIDES THE PHYSICAL CLAIM.
